verdict.rationale: Ramp ships built-in AI that takes work off users' hands. 'Ramp Intelligence' runs across its products, and four in-product agents handle auto-coding, fraud prevention, approval routing and payment. It also offers AI-filled memos and categories, and AI intake that parses contracts to populate request forms. These agents are fixed-function automations with a human confirmation required before money moves. The natural-language way to hand off arbitrary tasks runs through external assistants such as Claude or ChatGPT via Ramp MCP, not an assistant inside the Ramp UI. Missing for 10: an in-product conversational assistant that accepts arbitrary user-directed tasks, documentation of how users instruct or configure the built-in agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent behavior.
